paragraphs: Rav Shimi bar Adda. Mentioned in [Nazir 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.50b.8), where he raised a difficulty to Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Shimi bar Adda’s question to Rav Pappa. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3304&lang=en) cites it and tentatively compares the name with another entry.
